BiblicalUsage: Shobi was the son of Nahash of Rabbah, an Ammonite who brought beds and basins and food to David at Mahanaim when David was fleeing from Absalom. He came with Machir and Barzillai, and together they fed a hungry king and his people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that kindness from an unexpected quarter is still God's provision. An Ammonite fed David in his flight, and I believe God uses outsiders to carry His help.
